raw.query: SELECT SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(run_id,'_s','2'),'_tp','1') AS scale_label, p99_ms FROM provenance.v_pool_latency WHERE is_current=true AND experiment='g3_32b' AND run_id LIKE 'g3_32b:235b_tp8_%' AND sla_metric='ttft' AND p99_ms>1000 ORDER BY p99_ms LIMIT 1; -- plus equivalent for 8b_tp1 (s=5.15), 8b_tp2 (s=11.70); and SELECT COUNT(*) FROM provenance.v_pool_latency WHERE is_current=true AND experiment='g3_32b' AND pool IN ('encoder','both') (=0)
raw.observed: 235B-TP8 first TTFT p99>1000ms at scale_label='2p7108' (s=2.71, p99=1557ms); 8B-TP1 at '5p1537' (s=5.15); 8B-TP2 at '11p6997' (s=11.70); vision-pool runs in g3_32b=0
raw.evidence: Knee-below-8B holds (2.71 < 5.15/11.70), but g3_32b has no vision-pool rows so 'vision pool untouched by decoder scale' is asserted without empirical backing in v_pool_latency/v_grid_static_effective
